exposure: timing of dressing and staples removal
preterm premature rupture of the membranes (PPROM) vs intact membranes
chorioamnionitis at delivery vs no chorioamnionitis
outcome: Wound healing complications at 6 weeks postpartum
cohort: 920 women undergoing cesarean delivery at Hadassah-Hebrew University Hospital, Jerusalem between January 1, 2013, and October 31, 2014
finding: Timing of dressing and staples removal after cesarean delivery did not significantly affect wound healing complications.
